links.comparator_used: Retrospective validation alone (retrospective test-set estimates from the clinical data warehouse) as the basis for a go-live decision
links.outcome: Model discrimination (AUROC) of 12 lab-result prediction models, measured prospectively in a silent trial versus retrospectively
links.effect: Prospective AUROC was lower than retrospective for all 12 models, e.g. hematocrit 0.83 vs 0.86, white blood cell 0.69 vs 0.76, potassium 0.60 vs 0.67, sodium 0.71 vs 0.79, carbon dioxide 0.62 vs 0.69, magnesium 0.65 vs 0.70.
links.tradeoff: Needs dedicated personnel (engineering, data science, EMR integration, networking/security). Cloud cost for the roughly 5-week silent deployment was under $300.
links.quote: Across our 12 laboratory predictions tasks, AUROC in our prospective test sets were generally several percentage points lower than what is seen retrospectively.

design_hint: silent deployment with prospective evaluation before go-live
